subject.title: feat(codex): fork upstream-linked sessions at a message via thread/fork

question: Should OpenClaw make the generic AgentHarness sessionFork capability and upstream-link registry mutation helpers part of the supported public plugin SDK for upstream-owned session forks?
rationale: The implementation follows the intended core/plugin boundary, but the added SDK API is a persistent compatibility commitment that tests alone cannot define.

options.title: Accept the generic SDK seam
options.body: Keep the capability and registry helpers public, with Codex as the first implementation, after final-head live proof confirms the end-to-end session lifecycle.

options.title: Keep it Codex-internal for now
options.body: Rework the feature behind existing internal Codex ownership boundaries and defer public SDK exposure until another harness has a concrete need.

recommendation.title: Accept the generic SDK seam
recommendation.body: Keep the capability and registry helpers public, with Codex as the first implementation, after final-head live proof confirms the end-to-end session lifecycle.

likelyOwner.reason: Authored both the original fork feature and this Codex-specific follow-up, including the proposed plugin-SDK contract.
